findings.issue: notificationService.list() and unreadCount() use getSupabase() (anon client) instead of per-user authenticated Supabase client
findings.impact: All notification read operations use the anonymous client with RLS enforcing user_id filter — defense-in-depth weakness if RLS is misconfigured.
findings.fix: Refactor list() and unreadCount() to accept an optional SupabaseClient parameter. Pass req.supabase from the route handlers.

findings.issue: @here mention resolves identically to @everyone by selecting all workspace members without filtering for currently online/active users
findings.impact: @here is intended to notify only currently online workspace members, but the implementation notifies all members regardless of presence status.
findings.fix: Integrate with Socket.io presence tracking: query currently active user IDs from the Redis presence store or socket rooms when resolving @here.

findings.issue: Mention notification titles use truncated UUID (input.user_id.slice(0,8)) instead of resolved display name
findings.impact: Notification reads like 'a1b2c3d4 mentioned you' instead of 'Alice mentioned you'. Raw UUIDs are user-hostile.
findings.fix: Look up the sender's display_name from the users/profiles table before constructing the notification title.

findings.issue: Notification unread count polls every 30 seconds instead of using real-time WebSocket push
findings.impact: Users experience up to 30 seconds of delay between a mention being created and the notification bell badge updating.
findings.fix: Emit a 'notification:new' or 'notifications:unread_update' Socket.io event when notificationService.create() succeeds.
